comment: sptd mode only, temporary until CAS delivers these files. The game-demo ConfigMap mounted at /config is baked into the sealed launcher as descriptor files (opened as /proc/self/fd/N); the sptd source image (scripts/sptd/images/web-server) links /config/<key> to them, and the dispatcher checks the links. MY_POD_IP (Downward API status.podIP) is left out: the server binds 0.0.0.0 and only echoes that variable, so /env/MY_POD_IP answers 404. The command is the absolute /app/web-server. The demo's manifest and the sgx/cvm modes are unchanged.
